data.text: Bengaluru Traffic Advisory-Bakrid (May 28, 2026): Special traffic arrangements will be in place across Bengaluru for Bakrid prayers. Restrictions and diversions will apply in KG Halli, Pulakeshinagar, Chamarajpet, RT Nagar, MICO Layout & KS Layout between 5am and 2pm. Key stretches affected include Nagawara-Pottery Circle, Millers Road, Mysuru Road near BB Junction, RT Nagar 80 Feet Road, Bannerghatta Main Road & Outer Ring Road near KS Layout. Parking restrictions will also be enforced near prayer venues @blrcitytraffic
